about: The corpus of regression of the briefing: real, hard cases, one list for every family of problem seen. Offline cases run in jest at every change (tests/regression/regression.test.js); 'live' cases ask the real model before a deploy (bench/regression-run.mjs). A problem reported on a card adds its case here FIRST (red), then the logic is fixed (green). 'known' marks a weakness of the logic the case shows: the test is expected to fail, and fails when it starts to pass, so the mark is taken off. Titles and short passages of articles, for the use of the project only.
